We can absolutely run a 30-minute compact eval that splits the agenda so both people get focused time. Two options that work on our side tomorrow: 11:00–11:30 PT or 12:00–12:30 PT. If you prefer, we can structure as:

- 0–5m: quick intros + objectives
- 5–15m: product lead segment — model choices + prompts to validate business cases
- 15–30m: engineering segment — sandbox run, latency & cost demo, and integration notes

Ben I’m cc’ing for sandbox provisioning; I’ll attach the minimal preflight checklist and a claim link so they can join immediately. Diego can help with any calendar conflicts and send the invite once Maya confirms.

Inline preflight (short):
- Claim sandbox via: https://console.redwood.ai/sandbox/claim/SL-6789 (open in Chrome)
- Verify API key in console -> API Keys (copy key to a secure note; we’ll only demo read-only calls)
- Sample prompt to paste into the sandbox: "Summarize last quarter’s customer feedback and extract top 3 improvement areas."
- Confirm you can get a sample generation within ~300–500ms (we’ll show latency metrics live)
- Note any firewall/proxy blocks — allow outbound HTTPS to api.redwood.ai

Agenda (in invite):
- Intros (5m)
- Product focus: model & prompt validation (10m)
- Engineering focus: sandbox run + latency/cost discussion (15m)
- Next steps & trial expansion options (5m)

See you tomorrow at 12:00 PT. If anything changes ping me here and we can re-slot.

Thanks,
Karthik
